A financial support of GBP 10,000 for one year of study

University of Derby GREAT Scholarships 2025-26 is an opportunity offered by the University of Derby in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign. Under this programme, students from India will receive financial support of GBP 10,000 (each student) for one year of postgraduate study in the UK.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
hold an offer from the University of Derby to pursue a postgraduate program
have an outstanding academic background or relevant work experience
be classified as an international student for tuition fee purposes*
meet the English language requirement of the University of Derby
The eligible courses for this scholarship are Big Data Analytics MSc, Cyber Security MSc, and Information Technology MSc.

The students must pay the full international tuition fees for their chosen postgraduate course. This scholarship aims to partially offset this cost; however, applicants will still be responsible for covering the remaining fees.
A selected Indian student will receive financial support of GBP 10,000 for one year of study to pursue selected postgraduate programs in the UK.
Students awarded a GREAT scholarship are not eligible to receive any other scholarships or discounts from the University of Derby.
An essay of 500 words on the given topic they have studied, including why they found it interesting and how it has inspired them to apply for the course
The selected students might need to produce the following documents upon selection for the scholarship:-
A valid offer letter from the university
Academic transcripts, including marksheets and certificates
Copy of the payment slip of the application fee

The candidate will be selected based on the information provided in the application form and fulfillment of eligibility criteria.
Shortlisted applicants may be asked to attend a video interview with the selection committee.
Candidates should be willing to maintain contact with the British Council and act as an ambassador for the GREAT Scholarships, by sharing experiences of studying in the UK with future GREAT scholars.
As an alumnus of the GREAT Scholarships, the selected candidates should be willing occasionally to speak to potential candidates about their own experience of studying in the UK.
Students must be willing to represent the high standards of the GREAT brand by becoming an advocate for scholarships
Applicants should be interested in attending networking events of all UK-based GREAT scholars, and discuss experiences or capture perceptions of studying in the UK.
A student must be willing to demonstrate future contributions to capacity-building and socio-economic advancement through the benefits achieved after graduating from UK higher education.
Question: Who is offering this scholarship?
This scholarship is being offered by the University of Bristol, UK.
Question: Are there accommodation costs in this award?
There are no accommodation costs in this award.
Question: Are visa costs covered under this scholarship?
No, only tuition fees are covered.
Question: Can applicants apply before receiving an offer letter from the university?
No, they must have an offer letter to apply.
Question: What is the mode of application for this scholarship?
The mode of application is online through the official university website.
